ctx.x: Herman Chittison was a wonderful pianist. He worked with Zack Whyte. He didn't stay with the band long after I was there because he had a radio program over in Newport News over there in Kentucky -- not Newport News but just Newport, Kentucky.
He got to be on the radio over there and he stayed on that station for quite a while, quite a long time. That was before he came to New York.
